summary: Learn the principles of green finance and sustainable investment strategies in our expert-led training, designed to foster responsible financial practices.
lede: Green and sustainable finance applies environmental and social considerations to investment choices, risk management and capital allocation. For finance professionals, investment analysts and sustainability staff, this course develops practical skills to assess ESG factors, compare green and sustainability-linked bonds, and evaluate climate risks and net-zero strategies when shaping or reviewing investment portfolios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for forward-thinking professionals shaping how capital flows—and why.
outcomes: Regulatory Framework Application (TCFD, SFDR, EU Taxonomy)
modules: Introduction to Green Finance and ESG Strategy
Communicating ESG Performance and Engaging Stakeholders
